notes.title: 1.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Thanks again for all your awesome feedback and suggestions in the forums. I am happy to share another update for Reflex Unit : Strike Ops with the follows improvements and fixes!

Current version 1.0.6
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]IMPROVEMENTS

Gamepad Aiming has added stickyness.

In Co-op mode, dead players with no vehicles remaning now spectate until the end of the game and can complete the stage with the other players.

Co-op players are now visible on the mini-map.

Increased the speed of ground alignment to reduce crashes with terrain and bridges.
[p align="start"]FIXES

Improved render stuttering issue encountered by some players.

Fixed issue with co-op syncing of boss at end of first stage.

Fixed issue with co-op syncing of landing craft on first stage

Fixed animation jittering when enemy aircraft are destroyed and fall from the sky. 


[p align="start"]Please continue to share any issues or improvment suggestions you have for the game in the discussion forum and I will do my best to follow up with them.



Coming Soon: A new Free DLC Epilogue stage that wraps up the story after the last campaign mission. This will be available in the coming weeks, stay tuned for more news soon!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/778646cd8bf14217e9fce334333a930d702c8444.gif"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Thanks for playing!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Alex
[p align="start"]Robosaru Games

notes.title: Post Release Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



It’s been a few weeks since the launch of Reflex Unit : Strike Ops and I wanted to share an update on the fixes and improvements that have been rolled out since then based on your valuable feedback. 



Current version 1.0.5



IMPROVEMENTS

Aim Assist Option (Gameplay Menu).

Gamepad Analog Stick can control aim distant (when Aim Assist is Off).

Mouse aiming improvements.

Aim Dots can be disabled/enabled (Video Menu).

Music, VO and Sound FX volume level controls are now more adjustable.

DirectX 11 is now available as an optional render engine in Windows with support for Exclusive Full Screen mode (which may give better performance than the default Vulkan engine). 

To enable DirectX 11, add the following to the Launch Options in Properies > General:

-force-d3d11

FIXES

CO-OP Mode networking fixes for objectives across clients.

Various Japanese Language fixes.

On some systems that do not support Vulkan the game would not start (DX11 added as fallback render engine).

Game would sometimes unpause when inside settings menu.

Trucks would sometimes collide.

Achievements would sometimes trigger incorrectly.



Please continue to share any issues or improvment suggestions you have for the game in the discussion forum and I will do my best to follow up with them.



Thanks for playing!



Alex

Robosaru Games

notes.title: Demo Update and Campaign Preview
notes.notes:
Hi there pilots!



It won't be long now until  the full version of Reflex Unit : Strike Ops is released (still planning for an end of July release date - thank you all for your patience!). In the meantime, I am happy to share a few updates:



Demo Version Update:

NEW CONTROL MODES:

CAMERA RELATIVE (Default) - control your vehicle movement and shooting direction relative to the screen. 

VEHICLE RELATIVE - control your vehicle movement and shooting direction relative to the vehicle (similar to the classic beloved game "Desert Strike").

CO-OP MODE STABILITY IMPROVEMENTS

Fixed some issues found when leaving and rejoining a co-op session where some destroyed objects would not sync correctly.

WEAPON BALANCING

Your primary and secondary weapons have a greater contrast in strength, velocity, splash damage and capacity.

notes.title: Reflex Unit: Strike Ops Demo - May 2025 Update
notes.notes:
We’re excited to roll out a fresh update for the Reflex Unit: Strike Ops demo, with some new features and enhancements:


More Destruction! Now even more of the NEOTECH facilities can be destroyed, with more bombastic explosions. Looks out for pickups in the rubble!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/ad41cd4363c31ec3d0761550041e197c3e6b099a.gif

Improved Flight Model! Your helicopters now control more realistically with physics based intertia. The Scout Chopper is quick and nimble, the Cargo Chopper is heavy and more challenging to control and the Rescue Chopper is a good all rounder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/1e01b4b7cca55c70037eb410d2e5b9feaeb2856c.gif

Air Drops! You can now call in Ammo, Armor and Fuel air drops in the field for yourself, or you and your friends to use when playing co-op mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/c549c793199f091033cc4ed262499f9a56b39182.gif


Jump back in and check out the new features. We’d love your feedback!

notes.title: Reflex Unit: Strike Ops Demo - New Update!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to roll out a fresh update for the Reflex Unit: Strike Ops demo, with some new features and enhancements:


Co-Op Campaign Demo: The Campaign Demo stage is now available in Single Player or online co-op with up to 3 players. Team up and take on the challenge together!

Customizable UI Scaling: You can now adjust the User Interface size to better suit your screen and display setup.

Jump back in and check out the new features—we’d love your feedback!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who tried out the Strike Ops Demo during Steam Fest! The demo is still available, so if you missed it, no worries – it's here to stay!

Based on your incredible feedback, we’ve made several improvements to enhance the Strike Ops experience:

Building Explosions
Now, when you take down the evil NEOTECH bases, they explode and crumble with dynamic physics!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/6296083b2465fbf56621da41467a32b9f0af70a8.gif

Tuned Container Carrying
Carrying containers now incurs a significantly reduced movement penalty, so you can move faster and stay nimble.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/bcfa7589467131c662ca3cde6542379cfe416e22.gif

Increased Enemy Presence
The NEOTECH forces received reinforcements and a software update to enhance their area control – expect more action in the AO!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/e07805521f16f6e15a8db104d8f54db7009a82f3.gif

Remappable Controls
Customize your controls! Gamepad and Keyboard/Mouse layouts can now be configured to match your play style in the settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/3ccb044508cfdbdb0bae3a3300e7caf613c1a464.gif

Adjustable Camera
Adjust the Field of View (FOV) of the camera to your preference in the settings for an optimized view.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/1d89e08f5577c540bcac655546dd95a3a8b68460.gif

Disable Pause During Conversations
There’s now an option to disable auto-pause during conversations, so you can stay immersed in the action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/a103d8419bbcade176c35bd2d54921342b63a254.gif

Show All Objectives
You can now display all objectives on the map at once, giving you more flexibility to plan your mission strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/e8e826cfe271f14b472ac170f0df6f82d02ce8f4.gif

Change Vehicle
Swap your vehicle at any time by returning to the aircraft carrier – perfect for when you need a fresh approach.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/69067ade46f0a696c710c883033481701e6dac6e.gif

Special Surprise
At the end of the demo, watch out for a surprise appearance from a new contraption from one of NEOTECH's advanced research facilities…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/cfadc7f47fe792465953293e951f1101c474d6af.gif

Additionally, don’t forget that online co-op is available in the BETA branch, so invite some friends for some Strike Ops action together!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update
notes.notes:
We're thrilled by the feedback you've shared on Reflex Unit: Strike Ops since the demo launch last week!

Thanks to your insights, we're rolling out an updated version of the demo (just in time for Steam Next Fest!) with several key improvements, including:


 Adjustable FOV for a more customizable experience.
 Increased enemy variety and presence to amp up the challenge.
 Option to disable automatic pausing during communications.
 Enhanced Lock function UI for smoother gameplay.
 Graphic improvements, including V-Sync enabled by default.
 Plus, various other fixes and optimizations.

[previewyoutube=vNnf41VfeCw;full][/previewyoutube]

Please keep your feedback coming! We're committed to making Reflex Unit: Strike Ops the best it can be, with the full release planned for early 2025, including online versus and co-op multiplayer!
